'''Kinsa Doroturo''' was an academic and anti-[[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] activist. She hoped to reactivate [[Terman Station]], an orbital fortress that used to belong to [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] the Despot, and use it against the Hutt warlords.<ref name="SSR" />
